purpose: third-party (capytaine) mesh-refinement study: separates capytaine's own discretisation / near-field-integral error from any disagreement with the multipole reference that the case pool gates against

case_parameters.non_dimensionalisation: A/(rho*4/3*pi*a^3) and B/(rho*omega*4/3*pi*a^3): the *exact* sphere volume is used on both sides, so the polyhedral volume deficit of the mesh stays visible instead of being cancelled

criteria.statement: on the finest mesh (5120 panels) the third-party code must agree with the multipole reference within 1 % for every non-degenerate item, and the deviation must shrink for at least 90 % of the items; absolute deviation of a *coarse* mesh is never used as a statement about the reference
